integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically from partwise outside-neighbor counts. The computational artifact directly enumerates subsets and tests the defining conditions without assuming the proof criterion. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem is restricted to finite complete multipartite graphs in the nontrivial range \(1\le k<\Delta(G)\). The finite verifier checks all such isomorphism types through order 11 but does not replace the universal proof. An unindexed older treatment under the equivalent \(0,k\)-pitchfork terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact k-limited domination of complete multipartite graphs
